drhp.business: Mindpool provides IT staffing, payroll processing, recruitment services, web application development, digital marketing, and Global Capability Center (GCC) setup and management services. It serves clients across domestic and international markets, including Fortune 500 companies, through its India operations and its wholly owned US subsidiary, Mindpool Technologies Inc.
drhp.expansion: Mindpool is scaling its Global Capability Center (GCC) setup and management services and pursuing strategic collaborations with offshore development centers (ODCs) to access international talent pools and expand capacity, without a stated commissioning or capacity quantum. Profits for the year were allocated toward an unspecified expansion plan in lieu of a dividend.

It serves clients across domestic and international markets, including Fortune 500 companies, through its India operations and its wholly owned US subsidiary, Mindpool Technologies Inc.

group_structure.title: Related (RHP)
group_structure.body:
- **Mindpool Technologies Inc.** Wholly owned subsidiary incorporated in Delaware, USA (100% shareholding), engaged in IT staffing and Project Consulting services.
- **S A Tech Software India Ltd.** Former subsidiary/associate (divested in FY2021-22/FY2022-23, no longer a subsidiary); related-party transactions for sales, laptop rental, and office rent recorded during the year.

end_markets.title: End Markets (RHP)
end_markets.body:
- India (domestic market)
- United States / western markets (international)

demand_drivers.title: Mdna (RHP)
demand_drivers.body:
- Enterprises are accelerating investment in AI, Generative AI, cloud transformation, cybersecurity, data engineering, and digital modernization, increasing demand for specialized technology talent and workforce solutions.
- India's GCC ecosystem continues to grow rapidly, with global enterprises establishing and expanding GCCs to leverage India's talent pool, digital infrastructure and cost competitiveness.
- India's IT-BPM industry is expected to surpass USD 315 billion in revenue during FY 2025-26.
- Global macroeconomic conditions and cautious discretionary IT spending are influencing certain international markets, though demand for niche technology skills and outcome-based staffing remains resilient.
- Conditions in the western/US market remained challenging, leading to a slowdown that adversely impacted the US subsidiary's results.
- With a healthier order pipeline and continued cost discipline, the Company expects revenue and profitability growth to be sustained in the coming year.

capex_expansion.title: Expansion (RHP)
capex_expansion.body: Mindpool is scaling its Global Capability Center (GCC) setup and management services and pursuing strategic collaborations with offshore development centers (ODCs) to access international talent pools and expand capacity, without a stated commissioning or capacity quantum. Profits for the year were allocated toward an unspecified expansion plan in lieu of a dividend.

- licence/regulatory: information security management accreditation — evidence: IAS-accredited for its Information Security Management System (ISMS)

risks.title: Risks (RHP)
risks.body:
- Can delay client decision-making and lengthen sales cycles in certain international markets.
- Reduces near-term demand in certain overseas markets, as seen in the US subsidiary's decline.
- Faces pricing pressure from well-established domestic and global players.
- Requires continuous reskilling investment to remain competitive.
- Could impact margins and operations.
- Evolving requirements across geographies could affect operations.
- Could impact margins given the Company's US-dollar-denominated subsidiary revenue and cross-border operations.
- The US subsidiary, Mindpool Technologies Inc., reported a loss during the year due to challenging US market conditions and reduced overseas demand.

strategy.title: Strategies (RHP)
strategy.body:
- Scaling Global Capability Center (GCC) setup and management services as a strategic focus alongside the established IT staffing and consulting business.
- Broadening the digital business vertical (integrated digital marketing and technology-enabled solutions) to complement staffing and consulting.
- Strategic collaborations with offshore development centers to access international talent pools and improve efficiency, cost optimization and scalability.
- Expanding the digital sales team and upgrading sales effectiveness (tools, training, digital channels) in response to hybrid client engagement models.
- Continued focus on innovation, operational excellence, customer-centricity, and service diversification.
